reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; nothing invalid or directionally wrong is being proposed.

The cited text supports the classification: §13.2 (including 13.2(u) material compliance with Applicable Law) supplies a substantive express warranty package from the counterparty, and §13.5's disclaimer is expressly prefaced 'EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII', so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties — this is plainly not the 'AS IS' walk-away.

A meaningful performance standard and remedy exist: p0291 requires all Research activities to be performed in compliance with Applicable Law (GMP/GLP/GCP) with diligent efforts against Research Plan timelines (the functional analogue of 'professional and workmanlike'), while §14.1(b) (breach of warranties) and §12.6 (termination not the sole remedy; all other remedies preserved) leave real recourse.

The failed deterministic check (no 90-day/12-month period) is a phrasing/deal-type artifact rather than evidence of deviation: this is a research, development and commercialization collaboration with no software or fixed deliverables to conform to documentation, and product quality/GMP conformance is appropriately deferred to the Supply and Quality Agreements under §7.3. The rationale correctly notes the absent preferred sub-elements (fixed conformance period, repair/replace/refund mechanic, malicious-code warranty) as file notes rather than flagging them.

Minor over-reach in the rationale — reliance on §13.1(c)-(e) and §13.4 text not included in the cited paragraphs, and characterising the §14.1(b) indemnity as a general breach remedy — does not change the outcome, since compliant findings are retained as internal evidence and raise no negotiation issue.
